lines.zh: 我一步一顿，腿抬得很高。
lines.en: Each step jerks; my legs come up too high.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙根挪，背靠着它。
lines.en: I move along the wall with my back to it.

lines.zh: 我的一条胳膊垂着不动。
lines.en: One of my arms hangs and won't move.

lines.zh: 我脚后跟拖出一道湿痕。
lines.en: My heels drag a wet trail behind me.

lines.zh: 我停住，头歪向一边，再走。
lines.en: I stop, head tilts, then I move on.
I'm walking, but it doesn't look like walking.
I go around a heap of bones.

lines.zh: 我的脚步不齐，一长一短。
lines.en: My steps don't match — one long, one short.

lines.zh: 我慢慢往有声音的地方去。
lines.en: I drift toward whatever makes noise.
One of my feet drags.
I turn like something rusted.
I tremble the whole way.
I shuffle out of the alley.
Head down, I watch the ground as I go.

lines.zh: 我又经过那扇门，没进去。
lines.en: I pass that door again and don't go in.
I don't know where I'm walking to.
I stand there, trembling.

lines.zh: 我嘴里有声音，说不成话。
lines.en: There's a sound in my mouth that won't form words.

lines.zh: 我的手腕自己拧了一下。
lines.en: My wrist twists by itself.
I stand there, forgetting what I meant to do.
I tilt my head toward the sound.
I've heard something far off.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤下面有东西在动。
lines.en: Something moves under my skin.
My breath rasps in my throat.

lines.zh: 我身上有几处裂开的地方。
lines.en: Several places on me have split open.
I lift a hand, look at it, and let it drop.

lines.zh: 我一步也没走，可就累了。
lines.en: I haven't taken a step, and I'm already tired.

lines.zh: 黏液从我的嘴角流下来。
lines.en: Slime runs from the corner of my mouth.
I lean on the wall.
I'm listening to my own heartbeat.
That heartbeat doesn't feel like mine.
I blink, and it sticks.
You're within one arm's length of me.

lines.zh: 我脖子上的筋绷了一下。
lines.en: The tendon in my neck pulls tight.
Something runs from my mouth.
You've got a living warmth.
I drag one foot forward.
I reach for you, then pull my hand back.
I can't place you.
But I know you're alive.

lines.zh: 我对你张了张嘴，没出声。
lines.en: I open my mouth at you and nothing comes out.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脸，想认出来。
lines.en: I stare at your face, trying to place it.
I want to say something.
But only breath comes out.

lines.zh: 我嗓子里挤出一声闷响。
lines.en: A muffled sound squeezes out of me.
I double over and back away.
That cleared my head.
It hurts — I haven't felt pain in a while.
I lean on the wall or I'd go down.
Another split opens on me.
My knees won't hold.
I've gone down on my knees.
Still moving, can't stop.
I grip my own arm.
I smell it.

lines.zh: 我知道不该，可手伸出去了。
lines.en: I know I shouldn't, but my hand reaches out.
And I still want it.
I hold out one hand slowly.
My hand is shaking badly.
I've got it, and I don't drop it.
I sniff it a long time before eating.
As I eat, tears come.

lines.zh: 我不知道自己在做什么。
lines.en: I don't know what I'm doing.
Don't come so close.
I stop halfway through.
There's no taste in my mouth.
I remember this taste.
Long ago, it was like this.
I get one more mouthful down.
I want to eat it again.
You bump me and I lurch sideways.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的袖子才没倒。
lines.en: I grab your sleeve and don't fall.

lines.zh: 这一下我疼得叫了出来。
lines.en: That made me cry out.
My shoulder joint popped.
I hold the doorframe and step aside.
I steady myself against the wall.
You don't budge; I'm the one who backs off.
My arm has come out of place.
I push it back with my other hand.
I didn't mean to hit you; my legs won't obey.
There's nothing else here.
I remember someone.
Her face has gone blurred.

lines.zh: 我对着空气叫了个名字。
lines.en: I say a name to the empty air.

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴，叫不出名字。
lines.en: I open my mouth and can't say the name.
I stand in the doorway a long while.
My body doesn't obey me.
But I still remember.
I sink slowly down.

lines.zh: 我心里那点东西还没烂。
lines.en: That small part inside me hasn't rotted yet.
I bend for it and nearly fall.
I pick it up and can't grip it.
It rolled to my feet.
I turn it over to see the other side.
This cloth used to be mine.
I press my face into the old cloth.
I clutch it and stuff it into a torn pocket.
I pick up a wooden stick.
I use it to prop myself up.
It fell, and I can't pick it up.
The shadow over there shifts.
My head turns toward it first.
My body is faster than I am.
I do not want to move at all.
And it moves anyway.
I lift my hand — it isn't mine.
I hear myself make a sound.
That voice isn't mine.
I've lunged at it.
My feet have turned on their own.
Every step it takes, I drag one after.
I can't hold myself back.
I shake as I walk.
I try to grab the wall.
My fingers won't take hold.
Around this corner is where it is.
I'm panting like I ran the whole street.
I've bitten through my own lip.
The pain clears my head a moment.
I pause, then shuffle on.
My hand swings out.
My fist lands on its shoulder.
A brittle crack comes from under my hand.
It isn't what I wanted.
I pulled back.
I shake my hand and can't shake it off.
I've grabbed it.
My teeth sink into its sleeve.
My mouth is all iron taste.
I put all my weight into it.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼睛，先看见天花板。
lines.en: I open my eyes and see a ceiling first.

lines.zh: 我不知道自己躺了多久。
lines.en: I don't know how long I lay there.
I try my fingers; they won't move.
Then they move.

lines.zh: 我坐起来，身体不是原来的。
lines.en: I sit up, and my body isn't the same.
I sit against the wall and start with my toes.
My nails have gone black.
I smell something thick.
It's coming from me.
I pull myself up on the wall.

lines.zh: 火把我身上的东西烧得扭动。
lines.en: Fire makes the thing in me writhe.

lines.zh: 我摔在地上，骨头错了位。
lines.en: I hit the ground and bones shift wrong.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我身体里的东西在挣。
lines.en: Water floods in and the thing inside struggles.
I'm shoved and slide a long way.

lines.zh: 一支箭从我身上穿过去。
lines.en: An arrow goes through me.

lines.zh: 身体里的东西被激怒了。
lines.en: Whatever's inside me has been provoked.
Hunger won't let me stand.
Lightning strikes and my whole body clenches.
The ground's gone and I fall in.
